neighbours.label: contrast / comparison markers ("this is not the case", "unlike", "in contrast to", "by contrast"), the other side of the - pole's additive markers ("in addition", "plus", "alongside")
fire: Many assume the bridge is unsafe, but engineers say this is not the case.
The new tablet, unlike the older model, has no charging port.
City buses are crowded; rural routes, by contrast, are often empty.
Newspapers, in contrast to television, still cover local courts in detail.
Some fans believe the band split over money, which is not the case.
Our winters are mild, unlike those in the mountains.
Prices in the capital rose sharply; in contrast, rents in the north fell.
It is often said that bats are blind, but that is not the case at all.
quiet: Many assume the bridge is unsafe, and engineers are now checking it again.
The new tablet, along with the older model, has a charging port.
City buses are crowded; rural routes, in addition, are often late.
Newspapers, in addition to television, still cover local courts in detail.
Some fans believe the band split over money, and others blame the label.
Our winters are mild, as well as short and sunny.
Prices in the capital rose sharply; moreover, rents in the north rose too.
It is often said that bats are useful, since they eat many insects.

notes: In the probe, 'not the case' scored 0.39 of max, 'Unlike' 0.26, 'by/in contrast' 0.18-0.19, 'similar to' 0.10 and 'Otherwise' 0.03, while the additive twins scored 0.02-0.06. The fire median is borderline. Near misses swap in additive connectives.
